HOW GRANDISON CAN HELP

From a repair to a new room.

Bathroom installation & renovation

Whether you want a new suite, a shower room or a full bathroom renovation, start with the existing layout and what you want to improve. Discuss plumbing alterations and any finishing trades together so the quote explains the complete scope.

  • Full bathroom renovations →
  • Shower room installations →

Plumbing repairs & installations

Leaking taps, toilets, sinks and changes to pipework all need a clear description. For a replacement fitting, share photographs and a product link before ordering. For a repair, explain when the problem occurs and which fitting is affected.

  • Plumbing services →
  • Radiators & heated towel rails →

Boilers & central heating

Choose the right enquiry: boiler installation for a planned replacement, boiler servicing for maintenance, or boiler repairs for a fault. Central heating changes can include radiators, controls and pipework; describe the system as well as the room you want to improve.

  • Boiler installation →
  • Boiler servicing →
  • Boiler repairs →
  • Central heating →

BEYOND THE FIFE AREA

Edinburgh & surrounding enquiries.

Fife is our main service area. Edinburgh enquiries are considered subject to the location, scope of work and availability. Check with Connor before ordering products around an installation date or making access arrangements.

For other surrounding areas, send your postcode and a description of the job first. Coverage outside Fife has to be confirmed individually.

How to enquire about Edinburgh work →

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Do you cover smaller Fife towns and villages?

Yes, enquiries are welcome from across Fife, including places without a dedicated page on this website. Give your full postcode and the type of work so coverage and availability can be confirmed.

Can I combine bathroom, plumbing and heating work?

Describe all the work when you get in touch. A bathroom renovation may also involve pipework and a heated towel rail. Connor can discuss the scope and sequence before a quote is agreed.

Do you take enquiries outside Fife?

Edinburgh enquiries are considered subject to coverage and availability. For other surrounding areas, ask Connor directly before arranging work or ordering products around a proposed date.
